title: Unconsumed Funds in Respect of oBike's Exit from Singapore
what_it_is: Unconsumed Funds in Respect of oBike's Exit from Singapore

sections.label: LTA licensing bicycle-sharing operators
sections.summary: LTA will license bicycle-sharing operators under the Parking Places Act, allowing only operators with responsible and sustainable bicycle management plans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will license bicycle-sharing operators under the Parking Places Act, so that only operators with responsible and sustainable bicycle management plans can operate in Singapore.

sections.label: Licensing regime start date
sections.summary: The licensing regime will kick in by October 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Our licensing regime will kick in by October 2018.

sections.label: oBike deposit refund commitment
sections.summary: oBike's Chairman Shi Yi committed to a full refund of user deposits, and oBike is working out a process with CASE.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: On 1 July 2018, about one week after oBike announced its exit, oBike's Chairman Shi Yi had publicly and personally committed to a full refund of user deposits. oBike is now working out a process with CASE to refund user deposits.

sections.label: No user deposits required
sections.summary: With this change, none of the licence applicants require user deposits.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: With this change, none of the licence applicants require user deposits.

sections.label: Recalibration of light touch
sections.summary: The new licensing regime is a recalibration of the light touch taken in this phase.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The imposition of this new licensing regime is a recalibration of the light touch that we have taken in this phase.

sections.label: oBike fleet and user numbers
sections.summary: oBike had a fleet size of 20,000 to 30,000 and reported just over a million users.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The other question was how many accounts they have.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: They had a fleet size of 20,000 to 30,000, and oBike has reported that they had just over a million users.

sections.label: Answer to Member's question
sections.summary: The short answer to the Member's question is yes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The short answer to the Member's question is yes.

sections.label: Fairness of practice review
sections.summary: Whether the practice as a whole was fair or unfair is a matter for MTI and the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore to look into.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Whether the practice as a whole was fair or unfair, actually again, it is a matter for MTI and the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore to look into and perhaps make a decision about and take further action thereafter.
